notes.title: Version 1.1.1
notes.content:
In version 1.1.1 we've improved controller responsiveness at higher framerates.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed input lag on higher framerates.
[*] Fixed game freezing occasionally when entering controls screen in co-op.
[*] Fixed minor visual glitch on ball trails.
[/list]
Visit the official [url=https://shattergame.com/]Shatter website[/url] and follow PikPok on [url=https://twitter.com/PikPokGames]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/pikpokgames]Facebook[/url] for the latest news and updates!

Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Version 1.1.0
notes.content:
In version 1.1.0 we've addressed issues where the shatter ball would stutter while playing at a high refresh rate, issues where player leaderboard positions would display incorrectly, and we've made some changes to the balancing of circular levels and the Cold Shoulder boss.
 
[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed ball stuttering issue. 
[*] Fixed Leaderboard display issues.
[*] Adjusted controller sensitivity in circular levels.
[*] Boosted the power of the “blow” mechanic during the Cold Shoulder boss encounter.
[/list]
[h2][b]Known issues: [/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Issue where players are experiencing input lag.
[/list]
Thank you for all your feedback and support as work through these fixes!

If you're experiencing issues in Shatter Remastered Deluxe, you can reach our Customer Support team by emailing Support@PikPok.com. Please make sure to include the platform/OS you're playing on in your message.

Visit the official [url=https://shattergame.com/]Shatter website[/url] and follow PikPok on [url=https://twitter.com/PikPokGames]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/pikpokgames]Facebook[/url] for the latest news and updates!

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 Hotfix
notes.content:
A hotfix has been released addressing an issue pointed out by a number of players in the community. 

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where VSync wasn't initializing properly and where frame limiting was occurring when VSync was disabled
[/list]
[b]Note:[/b] We aim to address many of the issues raised by our community as soon as possible and will have hotfixes rolling out throughout the upcoming week.

Reminder: If you're experiencing issues in Shatter Remastered Deluxe, you can reach our Customer Support team at Support@PikPok.com. Please make sure to include the platform/OS you're playing on. 

Visit the official[url=https://shattergame.com/] Shatter website[/url] and follow PikPok on [url=https://twitter.com/PikPokGames]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/pikpokgames]Facebook[/url] for the latest news and updates!

notes.title: Shatter Remastered Deluxe is available now!
notes.content:
A classic reimagined, Shatter Remastered Deluxe brings back the brick-breaking action with updated visuals and a stunning remixed and remastered soundtrack, and it’s available on Steam now!

We are so thrilled to have the opportunity to introduce a new generation of players to the game that redefined the brick-breaking genre. With native 4K resolution, 120 FPS, and a remastered soundtrack from composer [url=https://module.bandcamp.com/]Module[/url], new players can finally share in the heart-thumping action that made Shatter (2009) such an unforgettable experience. 

[h2]BACK AND BETTER THAN EVER![/h2]
Dive into an immersive single-player campaign comprising 71 intense levels across 10 different worlds. Master mind-bending shots, launching balls, and altering trajectory by harnessing the unique Suck and Blow mechanic. Unleash power-ups like the Maneuveraball and Unstoppaball to chain massive combos together, and prepare your ultimate attack Shardstorm in preparation for formidable boss fights at the end of each world.

[previewyoutube=vmw3OvcvYog;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Key Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Vibrant 3D style presented across 10 distinct worlds.
[*] A unique “Suck and Blow” mechanic that gives you more control when targeting attacks.
[*] 71 levels of intense action that present new challenges as you progress.
[*] 9 incredible Boss battles that will push your brick-breaking skills to the limit.
[*] Includes five game modes:
[*] Story: explore the full Shatter Remastered Deluxe experience across 71 exciting levels.
[*] Endless: stay alive as long as possible to chase your highest score.
[*] Boss Rush: take on all 9 bosses back to back in the ultimate challenge.
[*] Time Attack: get the highest score you can in a limited time.
[*] Couch co-op: Team up with a friend and compete for the best score.
[*] Global leaderboards so you can track your high scores against the best brick-breakers in the world.
[*] Highly acclaimed original synthwave soundtrack, remixed and remastered in 5.1 surround 
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1937230/Shatter_Remastered_Deluxe/
Visit the [url=https://shattergame.com/]official Shatter website[/url] and follow PikPok on [url=https://twitter.com/PikPokGames]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/pikpokgames]Facebook[/url] for updates and more information.

notes.title: Shatter Remastered Deluxe coming November 2nd!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=RIiNPVobc2c;full][/previewyoutube]
We are proud to announce that Shatter Remastered Deluxe will be available on Steam on [b]November 2nd, 2022! [/b]

An acclaimed classic reimagined, Shatter returns this November in stunning 4K resolution, with a modern UI, and multiple visual improvements! Not to mention an amazing soundtrack remixed, and remastered in collaboration with the original artist and composer Jeremiah Ross a.k.a Module!

Shatter Remastered Deluxe comes stacked with new features and [b]four unique game modes[/b] to deliver a visually immersive experience. These game modes offer players exciting ways to experience an arcade classic as you demolish your way through 10 challenging worlds and 9 intense bosses!

Here's what players can expect from Shatter Remastered Deluxe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42398579/3a8f93c0e32b80c2bf57d396df05f0e6db1b38e5.png[/img]

[b]New Features: [/b]
[list]
[*] Play in 4K resolution at 120fps.
[*] Multiple visual improvements.
[*] Modernised UI. 
[*] Remixed and remastered in 5.1 Surround Sound. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42398579/65657f784e9065347c91be371fed62cc45f88044.png[/img]

[b]Game Modes:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Story:[/b] Explore the full Shatter Remastered deluxe experience across 71 exciting levels!
[*] [b]Endless:[/b] stay alive as long as possible to chase your highest score.
[*] [b]Boss Rush:[/b] take on all 9 bosses back to back in the ultimate challenge.
[*] [b]Time Attack:[/b] get the highest score you can in a limited time.
[*] [b]Couch co-op:[/b] Team up with a friend and compete for the best score.
[/list]
Don't forget to wishlist Shatter Remastered Deluxe on Steam today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1937230/Shatter_Remastered_Deluxe/

─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Want a behind-the-scenes look at how we brought the original Shatter soundtrack to life? Check out this video by composer Module:

[previewyoutube=WUrAi5hTaTU;full][/previewyoutube]

You can also still purchase the original Shatter (2009) soundtrack on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/20828/Shatter__Original_Soundtrack/
